command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: DeepSeek is overly restrictive because the standard read-only operation and type selectors are identifiable despite missing Project values.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Use a bounded protected runner to issue App 0x06/0x57 for each approved 0x00/0x01/0x02 type and parse the matching response layout.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: Master TBD and 10/5 timing remain preserved; installed interfaces and expected values are not guessed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run per-interface read-only queries with strict type/length/reserved-field validation and compare decoded capabilities to the SUT baseline.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds standard request types, schema-specific fields and measurable acceptance to an undefined source.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Reported capability does not prove driver loading, in-band transport operation or performance; those require separate functional evidence.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Using the wrong response layout can silently corrupt version or message-size interpretation and lead to unsafe later transport decisions.

project_override_considerations: A vendor inventory API is equivalent only if it reports the same type-specific interface capability fields with equal firmware/transport identity and schema evidence; raw 0x57 coverage remains unverified if skipped.
expected_evidence: Verified target/interface fixture and approved type matrix
Redacted per-type requests and complete responses
Decoded SSIF or KCS/SMIC version/message-size fields

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The Master method and criteria are absent/TBD rather than contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The capability-read purpose and standard operation are identifiable. Interface fixture, type scope, schema and expected baseline are execution-readiness inputs.

review_improvement: Restores safe read-only coverage with explicit SSIF/KCS/SMIC schema separation and prevents reserved-type probing, transport mutation and false driver-level claims.
independent_technical_reasoning: The same command returns different field sets by interface type, so a generic parser can appear successful while assigning SSIF PEC/transaction data to KCS/SMIC size fields. Automation must bind every response to the requested type, validate reserved bytes and compare only the fields defined for that interface; transport function remains outside this metadata test.
